faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Health Society Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Health Society Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Ayush Medical Officer (Homeopathy), 1 Data Entry Operator, 1 Microbiologist.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Health Society Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Downloadable from the website https://tirunelveli.nic.in) and send it to District Health Office, No.16/22, Old Police Hospital Road, Samathanapuram, Palayamkottai, Tirunelveli - 627002, by by hand or post, to reach by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.40,000 for Ayush Medical Officer (Homeopathy), Rs.17,500 for Data Entry Operator, Rs.44,000 for Microbiologist.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ayush Medical Officer: Bachelor of Homeopathic Medicine & Surgery with State Board/Council registration; Data Entry Operator: Computer Graduate or any Graduate with Diploma in Computer Applications; Microbiologist: MBBS, M.D (Microbiology) or M.Sc. Medical Microbiology. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Ayush Medical Officer must be registered with the respective State Board/Council such as Tamil Nadu Board of Indian Medicine/TSMC/TNHMC.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts are purely temporary for 11 months on contract basis under the National Health Mission. Posts will not be made permanent at any time. No claim to permanent employment, priority or concessions can be made later.

faq.question: Q9. Which places are covered by District Health Society Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: GPHC, South Vijayanarayanam-1, Block PHC - Ukkirankottai, GH Valliyoor.

faq.answer: Evidence of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate/SSLC/HSC Certificate); Evidence of educational qualification and mark statement (10th/12th/Degree/Provisional Certificate, Tally Certificate, etc.); Proof of Residency: Voter ID, Aadhar Card, Ration Card, Driving Licence and Passport; No Objection Certificate from the competent authority (if applicable); Experience Certificate (if applicable); Any other special records of significance from competent authorities as indicated in the selection criteria.
